$comment: Defined in spec/06-sessions.md §6.5 (Scribe Exchange Protocol v0.1)
title: SourceCreateRequest
description: JSON body of POST /v1/sessions/{id}/sources. For a file upload this JSON travels in the multipart 'source' part and the bytes in the 'file' part.

kind.description: Must be a kind the service lists in discovery.

input.description: audio: how the recording will arrive. Default chunked.

language_hints.description: audio: languages spoken. Each must be in languages.supported.

stt_model.description: audio: id from models.stt. Default: the one marked default.

url.description: file: fetch from here instead of uploading. Only when discovery says url_fetch: true.

format.description: audio: MIME type of the audio, one of discovery formats. Required for audio.

transports.description: audio: transport kinds the client can handle, in order of preference. Default ["put"].
